title: Landslide, Indonesia, 8 March 2022 (LS20220308IDN)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Landslide, Indonesia, 8 March 2022 (LS20220308IDN), from 1 dataset on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: LS20220308IDN**  This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides in Mount Talakmau, Pasaman & Pasaman Barat dsitricts, Indonesia as observed from a Sentinel-2 satellite imagery acquired on 04 March 2022 at 10:48 local time.
Within the analyzed area, about 6 km2 of landslides are observed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
